about.snapshot: Established in [Founding Year] and headquartered in [City, Maharashtra], Shivam Electrical Works is a government-licensed electrical contracting and engineering firm delivering turnkey HT/LT installations, custom-fabricated control panels, and compliant power distribution systems. Backed by dedicated project engineers, supervisors, and certified technicians, we manage every stage—from load planning and equipment supply to erection, testing, commissioning, and statutory utility approvals—on schedule and without compromising workplace safety.
fullStory: Shivam Electrical Works was founded in [Founding Year] with a clear engineering focus: delivering dependable, code-compliant electrical infrastructure that keeps factories, commercial complexes, hospitals, and residential developments running safely. Operating from our registered office in [City, Maharashtra] under Electrical Contractor License [License No.], we execute projects ranging from high-tension substations and overhead transmission lines to custom LT distribution panels, captive DG installations, and specialized earthing and protection networks.

Beyond site execution, our technical liaisoning team handles end-to-end coordination with state electricity supply utilities and the Chief Electrical Inspectorate—securing service line clearances, statutory safety certificates, and timely power release so our clients face zero regulatory bottlenecks. Whether executing a greenfield industrial plant or attending an urgent breakdown, our team brings structured site planning, calibrated in-house testing equipment, and full accountability from mobilization to handover.
